capabilities: Copy a selection or whole note as rich HTML plus plain text tailored to a destination app
Export notes or HTML files as portable Markdown with clickable obsidian:// wikilinks
Copy exact original source or rendered HTML markup as plain text
Embed local vault images as data URLs while keeping fenced code blocks and frontmatter intact
Configure enabled destinations, a default Quick Copy target, and per-destination link and image options
extras: Desktop-only: version 1.0.2 targets Obsidian Desktop and its desktop clipboard implementation. Manual installation via building the source; the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Other apps interpret clipboard HTML differently, so pasting Obsidian notes loses headings, tables, links, or code or carries unwanted markup.

requires.name: destination app such as Google Docs, Word, Notion, Slack, email, or WeChat

summary: Copy plugin that converts a note or selection into rich HTML, Markdown, or plain text tailored to a chosen paste destination such as Google Docs, Word, Notion, Slack, email, or WeChat.
